verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Lindy serves an llms.txt at docs.lindy.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes the documentation as agent-friendly .md pages, and the cited doc URLs are themselves markdown endpoints, so an agent can be pointed straight at them. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on using the docs with agents, and no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404).
